catalog.title: Decks
catalog.searchHelp: Search filters this list, not Lucky.
catalog.empty: No eligible English trivia decks in this category. Choose another category or use general trivia.
catalog.categoryHelp: Choose a category for Lucky. Arrows show its decks.
catalog.inventory: {count} published decks, including 155 English trivia decks with 4264 questions. More topics are planned, not yet available.
catalog.picked: Lucky picked “{name}”. Choose Flip or Type to start.
catalog.loaded: Loaded “{name}”. Choose Flip or Type to start.
catalog.changed: Cards changed while this request was pending. Nothing was replaced. Retry to use the current cards.
catalog.protect: Loading this deck will replace your current cards. You can export a copy, or switch without downloading.
catalog.interrupt: Your current session will end only after the new deck loads. The timer keeps running until then.
catalog.mixHelp: Combine random whole decks from this scope until there are at least 100 cards. Decks won’t repeat within a mix.
catalog.mixProgress: {cards} usable cards from {decks} decks loaded; target 100+.
catalog.mixNeedsDecks: A mix needs at least two eligible decks. Choose a broader category or turn off Mix decks.
catalog.mixInsufficient: This scope produced only {cards} usable cards across {decks} decks. A mix needs at least 100. Choose a broader scope or turn off Mix decks; your current cards were kept.
catalog.mixConflict: Cannot mix these decks: the question “{question}” has conflicting answers (“{first}” and “{second}”). Your current cards were kept.

deck.restored: Original cards restored. Custom additions removed.
deck.failed: Could not change cards. Your current cards have been kept.

quiz.description: Type your answer and let the game check it.
quiz.exactAnswer: Exact answers only. Case and leading/trailing spaces are ignored; internal spacing and punctuation must match. For open-ended answers, use Flip.

help.title: How to Use
help.gamepad: Sample Games — Browse and load bundled flashcard decks.
help.settings: Settings — Change separator, cards per game, timer, upload CSV, add cards manually, or export your dictionary.
help.darkMode: Appearance — The sun/moon button chooses Light or Dark. In Settings, choose System to follow your device. Choices apply immediately and are remembered in this browser when storage is available.
help.newGame: Flip — Reveal, then choose Correct or Wrong to record your own rating and advance. Previous/Next leave cards unrated. Recorded ratings are read-only until you try again.
help.newQuiz: Type — Submit or Skip to compare your answer with the expected answer. Choose Next card or See results when ready; the countdown keeps running. End Type stops early.
help.timer: Timer — The countdown continues during reveal, navigation and answer feedback in both modes. When time runs out, results show recorded outcomes and unrated or unattempted cards.
help.deeplink: Deep Links — Share ?cards=URL to load a remote CSV, or ?sample_game=ID for a bundled game.
